**Reclassify the `s056` missing-cast row. Jeremiah is in the section cast.**

The row `s056` (`jeremiah-22-10`) is in group `namedNotInCast`. The reported text names "Jeremiah son of Hilkiah". The `sectionCast` for this sample in `blind-replies.json` (blind id `c96933c6`) includes `jeremiah_son_of_hilkiah`. The refusal therefore did not come from a named figure missing from the cast. It came from uncertain presence of a cast speaker, plus a generic mourning crowd.

The same error appears in the README classification table. That table lists "Jeremiah with mourners" under "Named figure not in the section cast". Row `s077` ("the lord (king) of the parable") is also unnamed. It fits `genericRole` better than `namedNotInCast`.

Move `s056` to `speakerInCastButUncertain` (or `genericRole`). Then update `groups` and the README counts, which are currently 13/5/4/1. The 23 total does not change.
